description: Read authorized OpenTrain conversation summaries or messages. Omit conversationId to list summaries; provide conversationId to read messages. Requires messages:read scope and never creates conversations or sends messages.

conversationId.description: Optional conversation id. Omit it to list authorized conversation summaries instead of messages.

digest.description: true = add conditionalRead.digest to the result, so a later repeat read can pass it as ifNoneMatch. Default false: the result is unchanged.

direction.description: Message pagination direction when conversationId is provided.

filter.description: Conversation summary filter when conversationId is omitted.

ifNoneMatch.description: The conditionalRead.digest (24 lowercase hex characters) of a result you already hold, from any OpenTrain surface (CLI meta.digest is the same digest). Unchanged: result is withheld and conditionalRead.notModified is true, with hasMore/nextCursor/truncated kept. Changed: the full result with notModified false and the new digest. A result carrying a JobOps sync delivery is never withheld.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Defaults to the OpenTrain API route default.

unreadOnly.description: When listing conversations, return only conversations with unread messages.

name: opentrain_read_messages
